name: Council mode for multi-LLM second opinions
description: You frequently use multiple LLMs as a council to debate approach (Claude → ChatGPT → Gemini). This reduces the risk of being rail-roaded by one model and improves architectural/security judgement. FADE should make this a first-class, repeatable workflow for high-risk or complex decisions.

userStories.title: Generate a second-opinion brief for a PRD or story
userStories.description: FADE can produce a structured prompt pack and capture responses from multiple models (where configured).
acceptanceCriteria: Command `fade council <prd_id>` generates a 'council brief' (context + question + constraints) from repo context, FADE.md, and the PRD.
Council brief is saved to `fade/runs/<run_id>/council/` or `fade/council/` with timestamp.
If additional providers are configured, FADE can request and store their responses; if not, FADE stores the brief for manual paste into web tools.
Council output includes: recommended approach, alternative approaches, key risks, and 'what to watch for' during implementation.

userStories.title: Auto-trigger council mode on high-risk signals
userStories.description: FADE suggests council mode when work is complex, security-sensitive, or repeatedly failing.
acceptanceCriteria: FADE suggests running council mode when: complexity=complex, PRD flagged security risk, or K retries/BLOCKED occur.
Suggestion is non-blocking and recorded in telemetry as `council_suggested`.
Operator can opt-in via `fade council --accept` to proceed.
